segments.name: Revenue from subscriptions
segments.description: Sells paid access to Anghami music streaming and OSN+ TV series and movies, through app stores, websites and telco partners.
segments.evidence: We provide paid subscribers with access to: (i) commercial-free music streaming on the Anghami platform through our Anghami Plus and Anghami Gold subscription plans; and (ii) premium TV series and movie streaming on the OSN+ platform through our OSN+ Standard, Standard with Ads, and Premium (4K) subscription plans.

segments.name: Revenue from advertisement
segments.description: Earns impression-based advertising revenue from free Anghami and OSN+ Standard with Ads viewers, plus branded content for brands.
segments.evidence: We generate revenue from (i) impression-based advertising on Anghami's ad-supported free service and OSN+'s Standard with Ads tier; and (ii) non-impression-based services such as production and branded content.

segments.name: Revenue from live events
segments.description: Earns revenue from concert ticket sales, sponsorships and food and beverage sales at live events run through Anghami Spotlight.
segments.evidence: Anghami generates revenue primarily through concert ticket sales and sponsorships, F&B sales

revenueModel.text: Paid subscribers pay for Anghami and OSN+ subscriptions, advertisers pay for impression-based and branded content, and ticket buyers and sponsors pay for live events.
revenueModel.evidence: Subscribers can access and pay for our services through direct channels, including the Apple App Store, Google Play Store, and our websites, or through Telco and other B2B partners.
